info.title: agent-loop REST and SSE API
info.description:
The HTTP API of the agent-loop runtime (package api). docs/04-contracts-and-tests.md §1 and §2 describe the behaviour behind each operation.

Stability: every operation carries `x-stability`. `stable` is the public API clients build on: every `/v1` route except `/v1/debug/*`. Within v1 its paths, parameters, status codes and documented fields change only compatibly. `internal` marks routes for operators and the bundled debug console: `/healthz`, `/readyz` and `/metrics`, which sit outside `/v1`, and `/`, `/ui/` and `/v1/debug/*`, which the server serves only when started with `-debug`. Internal routes may change in any release.

Identity: every route except `/healthz`, `/readyz`, `/metrics`, `/`, `/ui/` and `/v1/openapi.json` needs one, and an unmatched route needs one too; without it the server answers 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`. A server with `AGENT_LOOP_API_KEYS` takes `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; a server started with `-trust-identity-headers` (development only) instead trusts `X-Tenant-ID` and `X-Principal-ID` (UUIDs) and `X-Role` (`admin`, `operator`, `member` or `viewer`; `admin` when absent) as sent.

Errors: every error the handlers produce is an `Error` body. Request bodies are capped (1 MiB by default); a larger one answers 413. A caller who may not read a session gets 404 for it and everything in it; one who may read it but not do more gets 403.

Durations (`max_runtime`, `timeout`, `backoff`, ...) are integer nanoseconds. Times are RFC 3339; an unset time is `0001-01-01T00:00:00Z` unless the schema says it is omitted.

get.summary: Debug console page (served with -debug)

404.description: Any other path that no route matches.

get.summary: Debug console assets under /ui/ (served with -debug)

200.description: A static file of the console, by its path below /ui/.

get.summary: Liveness
Readiness: the store answers a ping within 2s
Prometheus metrics (served when the server has metrics)

200.description: Metrics in the Prometheus text format.

get.summary: This document
The configured agents with their instructions (served with -debug; admins and operators)
The tools the caller's tenant's runs may call (served with -debug; admins and operators)
List the agents the caller's runs may use
get.description: The config file's agents (`source: config`) and the tenant's (`source: api`, with `version`), by name. Only admins and operators see `instructions`, and the config file's only when the server runs with -debug.

put.summary: Create or replace one of the tenant's agents (admins)
put.description: The name comes from the path; a `name` in the body is ignored. Unknown fields answer 400.

409.description: The config file defines an agent of this name (`conflict`).

delete.summary: Remove one of the tenant's agents (admins)

post.summary: Create a session owned by the caller (not viewers)

project.description: Optional label, trimmed, at most 200 bytes; sessions sharing it share project memory.

get.summary: List the tenant's sessions the caller participates in (all of them for admins and operators)

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Only sessions with this project label.

get.summary: Get a session
List a session's messages the caller's role may read

post.summary: Post a human message, answering an agent's question or starting a run
post.description: Without `run`, the message answers the oldest open `ask_human` question of the session's runs, if any. With `run` (or an `Idempotency-Key` header) it starts a run with the message as input `message`; an invalid run answers 400 and posts nothing, and a reused idempotency key answers 201 with `replayed` and posts nothing.

run_error.description: The run could not start once the message was stored.

get.summary: List a session's runs
List a session's participants

put.summary: Add a participant or change its role (session owners)

post.summary: Ingest a document into long-term memory
post.description: Needs write access to the session. The content, at most 1 MiB, is cut into parts that are each embedded and saved with provenance; every part is saved, or none.

name.description: The document name kept as provenance.

post.summary: Ingest a text or JSON artifact into its session's long-term memory

413.description: The artifact's content is over 1 MiB (`validation_error`).

post.summary: Start a run in a session

schema.description: Needs `workflow.stages` or `template`. `idempotency_key` takes precedence over the header; a key reused in the same session answers the earlier run, in another session 409.

template.description: A workflow template from the server's config file.

get.summary: Get a run
List a run's events the caller's role may read, in sequence order

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Only events with a greater run sequence.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many events before visibility filtering; 0 means all.

get.summary: Stream a run's events as server-sent events
get.description: Replays the stored events after the cursor, then live ones, in sequence order, and closes after the run's terminal `run_state_changed`. Each event is `id: <sequence>`, `event: <type>` and `data: <EventEnvelope>`. With `deltas=1` it also carries `agent_message_delta` events (`data: <Delta>`, no `id`). A `: heartbeat` comment every 15s does not advance the sequence. Since EventSource cannot send headers, the API key may be passed as `access_token`.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Resume after this run sequence; takes precedence over `after`.

get.summary: List a run's artifacts
Download an artifact's content as an attachment
get.description: Served with the artifact's MIME type (`application/octet-stream` if it does not parse), `Content-Disposition: attachment` with its name, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox`.

get.summary: List every version of the artifact's name in its session

post.summary: Ask for a run to be canceled
Resume an interrupted, paused, failed or timed-out run

409.description: The run cannot be resumed, or another process holds it (`conflict`).

post.summary: Re-execute a finished run from its recorded model and tool outputs, and wait for the copy
post.description: The copy is a child run in a new session. The response is its result, whatever its status.

422.description: The run was recorded before requests were stored (`not_recorded`).

get.summary: List the tenant's approvals in the runs the caller participates in (all of them for admins and operators), oldest first

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Only this run's; 404 if the caller may not read it.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `requested` leaves out approvals past `expires_at`; `all` shows such an approval as `requested`.

200.description: A page of approvals; a full page carries `next_after`.

post.summary: Approve or reject a requested approval as the caller

payload.description: Stored as the resolution; an `ask_human` question takes its `answer`.

bearerAuth.description: An API key from `AGENT_LOOP_API_KEYS`, which fixes the caller's tenant, principal and role.

accessToken.name: access_token
accessToken.description: The API key as a query parameter, accepted only by the SSE stream route.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Used when the body has no `idempotency_key`.

ValidationError.description: The request is malformed or invalid (`validation_error`).

Forbidden.description: The caller's role does not allow this (`forbidden`).

NotFound.description: No such resource, or one the caller may not read (`not_found`).

Conflict.description: The idempotency key belongs to another session, or the state forbids this (`conflict`).

TooLarge.description: The request body is over the server's cap (`validation_error`).

NoMemory.description: The server has no embedding model (`not_implemented`).

memories.description: The IDs of the saved parts.

retryable.description: True on 503, where the request may be sent again after `Retry-After`.

MemoryScope.description: `project` needs a session with a project; `tenant` needs an admin or operator.

parent_run_id.description: The original run of a re-execution.

workflow.description: The workflow the run started with.

output.description: The stage outputs of a finished run.

cancel_requested.description: Cancellation was asked for; the process executing the run stops it.

EventEnvelope.description: The `data` of an SSE event; it never carries `hidden_payload`.

request.description: What is to be approved: a tool call (`tool`, `input`), a stage gate (`gate`, `stage`, `output`) or an agent's question (`gate: input`, `question`).

input_schema.description: JSON Schema the run input must satisfy.
